summary: Under matched conditions, classifier-head fine-tuning (\textsc{cls}) paradigm consistently outperforms the LLM-as-Judge sequence-to-sequence (\textsc{s2s}) on binary hallucination detection. We trace this gap to the representations induced by the two objectives. Static analysis shows that \textsc{cls} learns a task-specific discriminative direction, pushing hidden states into a clear two-cluster geometry with stronger class separation and linearly decodable label information. By contrast, \textsc{s2s} relies on the pretrained language-modeling head to make decisions. This minimizes the pressure to reorganize representations, leaving the hidden states much closer to the pretrained backbone. Our analysis also reveals that the \textsc{cls} signal saturates before the final layer, after which upper layers form a plateau of statistically interchangeable and largely redundant representations. However, endpoint redundancy alone does not show whether these layers are dispensable during training. Further training-dynamics analysis reveals 1) a lower pretrained substrate, 2) a narrow upper-middle \textbf{InfoWindow} where task information emerges, and 3) a later-synchronizing upper plateau that mirrors this signal. This mechanism motivates us to remove layers above the InfoWindow. Truncating 31\% of the network leaves accuracy unchanged within seed noise on Qwen3-4B and 8B and cuts latency by $1.4\times$. The same depth fraction, fixed before any analysis of the target models, transfers to Llama-3.2-3B and Mistral-7B-v0.3, and the layer structure behind it reappears there and on QNLI and SST-2. We hope this helps guide efficient task-specific LLM design.

AI.brief_summary: 在匹配条件下比较分类头微调与 seq2seq 两种目标对 LLM 幻觉检测的影响，用层间表示几何与训练动态分析发现任务信息集中在中上层「InfoWindow」，并据此裁剪 31% 的层数，在保持精度的同时降低延迟。
AI.relevance_reason: 其层间探测、按深度定位任务信号涌现窗口并做冗余层截断的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 推理状态在哪些层生成、上层是否可省及动态计算成本；但研究对象是纯文本幻觉检测，不涉及多模态视觉推理。

title: When Does Experience Memory Help Closed-Loop LLM Driving Agents? A Controlled Evaluation with Resampled Warmup Pools, Token-Matched Fillers, and Audited Baselines
summary: When does experience memory help a closed-loop LLM driving agent? Published gains cannot say, because the two factors we find to matter most, which warmup experiences the pool contains and what any injected tokens do to the prompt, are controlled in none of them. We answer with a controlled evaluation on one audited HighwayEnv testbed (1Hz, gpt-4o-mini for the decisive contrasts). We treat the warmup pool as a resampled random factor (ten disjoint pools) and add token-matched irrelevant-filler controls, oracle-certified diagnostics, caution-pricing metrics, and quantified audits of the baseline ports. The probe suite spans flat-text retrieval (a DiLu port), a single-frame grid port (RESPOND-inspired), our episodic temporal-graph memory, a retrieval-free consolidated rulebook, and a flat K-step observation-history baseline. Four findings follow, each a property of this testbed. (1) Headline memory gains belong to the warmup draw. The reported pool is the best of ten for both retrieval memories, which beat No-Memory in only one pool of ten (sign test p=0.011), and even the rulebook's apparent pool-immunity collapsed on five fresh draws. (2) No retrieval design tested exceeds token-matched filler. The collision-only merge ceiling is reached by a single 15-token caution instruction, and metrics that price caution erase the rulebook's lead. (3) Representational sophistication is nowhere robustly operative. (4) Baseline port quality silently inverts conclusions. On this testbed, a single-pool comparison without filler controls would have reported memory gains that these controls reverse. We release the testbed, audited ports, seeds, and caches.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在单一 HighwayEnv 闭环驾驶测试台上受控评估 LLM 智能体的经验记忆，通过重采样 warmup 池、token 匹配的无关填充对照、oracle 诊断与基线移植审计，检验检索式记忆、情景时序图记忆、规则手册等设计是否真有收益。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「注入 token 须与无用填充对照」「表示复杂度未必真正起作用」「基线移植质量会反转结论」的做法，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据或 latent token 的贡献分配与评估偏差时借鉴；但研究对象是文本驾驶智能体的经验记忆，与多模态 latent 推理无直接关联。

title: How Language Models Organize Task Information
summary: Dense linear probes assess task readability from language model (LM) representations, but do not directly reveal how many features suffice for prediction. We measure readout sparsity with \(k^*\), the smallest feature count found by a fixed search protocol that recovers 95% of dense-probe AUROC above chance. We evaluate 19 LMs from five labs on 14 core tasks. Ten base models give the nine reliably readable tasks similar feature counts and nearly the same order. This agreement extends to the selected features themselves, which on three tasks show cross-model response correspondence beyond class-mean differences and a label-correlation-matched null. Instruction-tuned deployment selectively reduces \(k^*\), with both weights and input format contributing. In controlled synthetic experiments across 20 models, successfully learned targets admit single-feature readouts, whereas readable controls require tens of features. Reference-model \(k^*\) is associated with label requirements across eight students, following an empirical scaling of \(N^*\propto(k^*)^{0.65}\). After continual learning, saved heads can fail while linear readability remains high, and recovery requires fewer labels than initial task learning under the tested procedures. Pruning reduces linear readability, with wider pre-pruning readouts generally associated with larger losses. These findings distinguish task readability from readout sparsity and establish their complementary value for predicting learning requirements and diagnosing LM changes.

AI.brief_summary: 提出以 k*（固定搜索协议下恢复 95% dense-probe AUROC 所需的最少特征数）度量读出稀疏性，在 19 个语言模型、14 项任务上比较特征数与所选特征，并考察指令微调、合成任务、标签需求缩放及持续学习与剪枝后的变化。
AI.relevance_reason: 稀疏探针可读性度量或可借用于检验 VLM 内部状态是否保留视觉与任务必要信息，k* 与标签需求的经验缩放也可能为 latent 监督量估计提供线索，但该文仅涉及纯文本模型，迁移性需核查。

title: Engram Memory Network: Brain-Inspired Prototype Explanations
comment: Accepted at IJCNN 2026 (IEEE WCCI 2026). 8 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables
summary: Artificial intelligence systems are increasingly deployed in high-stakes decision-making. In response, prototype-based models in explainable AI have attracted growing attention for their ability to retrieve visually similar examples as faithful explanations. Although these models achieve competitive classification accuracy, they often exhibit degraded explanation quality across datasets with varying characteristics, limiting their practical applicability. We draw on insights from cognitive neuroscience, particularly the human memory system, which encodes input-relevant information into representations that support recognition. We propose an Engram Memory Network (EMN), a model that emulates the ventral visual stream and inferior temporal cortex in the human brain. Central to this model is a Hopfield-inspired memory module that iteratively retrieves representative prototypes. These memory-refined latents are used for both reconstruction and classification, encouraging the selected prototypes to capture input-relevant information across diverse datasets. To address the lack of standardized evaluation for prototype explanations, we assess three complementary aspects: perceptual similarity (LPIPS and DISTS) for perceived resemblance, subclass alignment, measuring whether prototypes match the input's fine-grained category beyond supervised labels, and information preservation (NMI), measuring how much input information is captured by selected prototypes. Experiments show that EMN improves visual similarity by 17.06%, subclass alignment by 104.57%, and NMI by 42.42% on average across CIFAR-10/100, MNIST, HAM10000, and CUB-200, while achieving the highest average classification accuracy (87.62%) among all methods. These findings underscore the effectiveness of neuroscience-inspired explanation mechanisms in advancing the interpretability and reliability of prototype-based models.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Engram Memory Network，模拟腹侧视觉流，用 Hopfield 式记忆模块迭代检索代表性原型，将记忆精炼后的 latent 同时用于重建与分类，并从感知相似度、子类对齐和信息保留三方面评估原型解释质量。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「迭代检索并精炼 latent 状态、以原型作为可检验视觉证据」的机制，可能为 LVR 的循环式状态更新与视觉证据筛选提供线索，但该工作面向静态图像分类，不含 VLM 推理与 latent 推理轨迹。

title: RITE: Evaluating End-to-End Resilience to Silent Tool Errors in E-Commerce Agentic Systems
summary: Tool-using LLM agents increasingly answer e-commerce queries through multi-step tool interactions. The expected output of a tool call can shift between agent development and execution, allowing a plausible but incorrect value to be returned without an explicit failure signal. These silent errors may propagate through subsequent decisions into final answers. To study agents' resilience across this end-to-end process, we formulate Silent-error Resilience Task, an interactive task that evaluates whether they complete the original query after a silent error corrupts an intermediate state. We introduce RITE, a benchmark built from human-authored industrial workflows and production-log-derived inputs. To enable controlled and reproducible evaluation, we use a semantic error taxonomy to inject errors into fixed workflow prefixes, freeze recorded tool behavior, and let agents continue freely. It contains 167 matched units across nine e-commerce workflows, yielding 501 silent-error, correct-value, and explicit-failure instances. Across 10 recent LLMs, silent errors roughly halve task success and are consistently harder than explicit failures. Recognition, use of an available verification path, and integration of the resulting evidence form successive bottlenecks. We also propose a light State Checker as an intervention to test whether resilience can be improved.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Silent-error Resilience Task 与 RITE 基准，在电商多步工具调用中向固定工作流前缀注入无声工具错误并冻结工具行为，用 167 个匹配单元评估 LLM agent 能否识别、验证并纠正被污染的中途状态。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽非视觉推理，但其对中间状态污染、验证路径使用与证据整合的评测和 State Checker 干预，可供核查 latent 或视觉状态被错误写入后如何检测与纠正。

title: GRADUS: Discovering and Recovering Agent Lessons from the Environment's Latent Syllabus
summary: Training LLM agents for policy-constrained tool environments, such as an airline backend with booking, refund, and cancellation policies, requires tasks that exercise the environment's rules individually and in combination. Existing synthesis pipelines let a model propose tasks and retain only those it immediately solves, biasing training data toward easier behaviors. We introduce Gradus (Graded Rungs of Ascending Difficulty from an Underlying System), which decouples what a task should teach from the concrete task and solution used to teach it. Without seed tasks, Gradus treats a fixed environment as a latent syllabus, extracting guarded behavioral operators that capture how actions depend on current conditions and how their effects reshape subsequent decisions. It composes these operators into increasingly demanding tasks while using corpus-level feedback to target missing outcome combinations. Crucially, Gradus jointly calibrates tasks and solutions against the environment: execution feedback identifies which side to refine while preserving the intended behavioral requirements. Verification thus becomes a recovery signal rather than a terminal filter, coupling coverage-guided exploration with the preservation of difficult examples. From off-the-shelf backbones, the resulting curriculum lifts a 30B model from 59% to 89% on $τ^2$-Bench and from 47% to 83% on CAR-Bench with an Opus 4.5 proposer, and to 76% and 62%, respectively, with an open-weight Qwen3-235B proposer. These results show the value of jointly controlling which behaviors are explored and which survive into verified training data.

AI.brief_summary: Gradus 将固定的工具环境视为潜在课程表，从中抽取带条件约束的行为算子并组合成递进任务，再用语料级反馈补齐缺失的结果组合，同时联合校准任务与解法，把执行验证当作修复信号而非终端过滤，从而提升 agent 在 τ²-Bench 和 CAR-Bench 上的表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本 agent 任务合成，与视觉推理无直接关系；但「验证作为恢复信号而非过滤」和覆盖导向的轨迹构造，可供核查 LVR 轨迹训练中哪些样本与行为组合能进入监督，以及任务难度与解法的联合校准如何影响贡献分配。

title: SliMOO: Interpretable Multi-Objective Evolutionary Search for LLM Depth Pruning
summary:
As large language models (LLMs) grow more powerful, their scale makes them costly to serve. Depth pruning offers a practical route to efficiency by directly reducing memory and latency without hardware-specific support. However, we observe that transformer layers exhibit markedly different task-dependent layer contributions, whereas existing depth-pruning methods ignore this heterogeneity and thus tend to optimize for a narrow domain or benchmark rather than preserve broad capability. This suggests that LLM depth pruning should be formulated as a multi-objective optimization problem rather than a single-score ranking problem.
  We propose SliMOO, an interpretable multi-objective evolutionary search framework for LLM depth pruning. SliMOO first uses single-layer removal probing to construct a task-layer importance map, which provides an interpretable view of task-shared and task-specific layers and serves as a search prior. It then performs a Pareto-aware evolutionary search for pruning masks, where candidates are generated under the guidance of the task-layer prior, scored by their deviation from the dense model on each task, and retained through NSGA-II environmental selection. Across the Llama-3.1 and Qwen3 model families, SliMOO consistently achieves stronger multi-task trade-offs than rule-based, greedy, and scalarized baselines. For example, on Llama-3.1-70B at 25% sparsity, it improves the math-domain average from 24.33% to 34.40% and the code-domain average from 35.03% to 39.14%. Code will be made available at https://github.com/AMD-AGI/SliMOO.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 SliMOO，将 LLM 深度剪枝建模为多目标优化问题：先用单层移除探测构建任务—层重要性图作为搜索先验，再用 NSGA-II 做 Pareto 感知的剪枝掩码进化搜索，在 Llama-3.1 与 Qwen3 上取得更好的多任务折中。
AI.relevance_reason: 其逐层移除探测得到的任务共享/任务特异层贡献图，可供核查 VLM 中承担视觉证据的层如何做贡献分配；多目标 Pareto 搜索也可能为 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本权衡提供方法参照，但文中无视觉或 latent 状态内容。

title: LatBridge: Efficient and Stable Model Replacement in Latent-Communication Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems rely on communication to complete tasks, and latent communication passes continuous representations to reduce text generation and re-encoding. However, multi-agent systems must reconfigure agent models, whereas existing latent-communication methods are built for fixed model combinations, so their interfaces may fail after replacement. Our pilot study confirms this interface failure and identifies the requirement for interface reuse after model replacement. We present LatBridge, which connects agent models through a shared Bridge and separate interfaces under a shared latent-communication protocol. After agent model replacement, LatBridge reuses unchanged interfaces, selects matching low-rank interfaces, and combines them through the Bridge, training only missing ones with all models frozen. The Bridge processes source representations in the basic mode and constructs target input without autoregressive generation in the accelerated mode. Experiments support effective communication after model replacement, with mean basic-mode accuracies of 14.8% on MATH and 27.3% on ALFWorld next-action prediction across eight small-model configurations. Analyses examine the factors supporting task accuracy and communication efficiency.

AI.brief_summary: 论文关注多智能体 latent communication 中更换智能体模型后接口失配的问题，提出 LatBridge：用一个共享 Bridge 搭配各模型独立的低秩接口形成可复用的潜在通信协议，替换模型后冻结全部模型、只训练缺失接口，并在加速模式下非自回归地由源表示构造目标输入。
AI.relevance_reason: 其跨模型 latent 表示的翻译、低秩接口组合与冻结训练方式，可能为 LVR 中视觉旁路的状态注入或不同模块间潜在表示对齐提供可核查的方法线索，但论文本身不涉及视觉推理任务。

title: Privacy-preserving inference on hosted models: a learned input-embedding transform for frozen Qwen3.8-27B
summary: Every prompt sent to a hosted language model is readable by whoever runs it. We study whether the prompt can remain on the client while the host receives transformed vectors that stand in for it. A language model converts text to vectors exactly once, with a public lookup table; we perform that step locally and pass the vectors through a small trained network (55.6M parameters) before they leave the perimeter. The host runs a frozen 27B model (Qwen3.8-27B) on the transformed vectors and never receives text or token ids. We train the transform against the frozen model as a fixed judge, combining a forward-KL utility term with an auxiliary term that pushes each vector away from its original direction. On 1,490 MMLU questions held out from training, the transform costs 1.5 points of accuracy (80.7% vs. 82.3%), breaking 68 of the 1,226 questions the unmodified model answers correctly (5.5%), while 30.1% of content tokens no longer decode to their original token under a nearest-neighbour lookup.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究托管模型的隐私推理：客户端本地完成 token 到向量的查表，再用 55.6M 参数的小网络变换输入嵌入后交给冻结的 Qwen3.8-27B，以 forward-KL 效用项叠加「偏离原方向」的正则项训练，并在 1,490 道 held-out MMLU 题上测量精度损失与最近邻可解码比例。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「变换嵌入＋冻结下游模型＋最近邻解码」的评测方式，可供核查下游能取用多少原始信息，可能迁移到 LVR 中 latent 视觉内容保留与信息坍缩的度量，但属纯文本且与视觉推理无直接关联。

title: COMPASS: Routing via Capability-Oriented Model Profiling with Adaptive Search, Selection, and Tool Use
summary: LLM routing aims to select a capable model at low cost, but specialized routers can require updates as models and tasks change. We propose COMPASS, an agentic router in which an LLM follows a routing recipe, gathers performance and cost evidence through tools, and optionally inspects candidate answers before selecting a model. Our evaluations on LLMRouterBench and DeepSWE show that agentic routing can improve accuracy and lower model-call cost relative to specialized and trained routing baselines, without routing-specific training. On LLMRouterBench, COMPASS reaches 69.85% accuracy at \$139.57, compared with RLCascadeRouter's 69.14% at \$180.22. On DeepSWE under fixed five-fold cross-validation, it reaches 78.1% at \$215, compared with 74.1% at \$500 for the best single model. COMPASS also supports routing across benchmarks and adapts to an expanded model pool by reading new evaluation records, without changing the router's weights or prompt.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 COMPASS：让 LLM 按路由配方通过工具收集候选模型的性能与成本证据，并可选地先查看候选答案，再决定调用哪个模型，无需路由专项训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本模型路由与 LVR 主线无直接交集，但其「先取证、查答案再决策」的流程可供核查为 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的停止与计算分配提供成本感知的决策类比。

title: From Generic to Dedicated: A Novel Optimizer for Online Continual Learning
summary: Online Continual Learning (OCL) requires models to learn from non-stationary data streams under a strict single-pass constraint, making them highly susceptible to catastrophic forgetting. While existing studies have explored various strategies from data, architecture, and optimization perspectives, the optimizer often directly uses generic approaches such as SGD and AdamW. In this work, we reveal a new link between optimization dynamics and OCL needs by recasting Polyak-Ruppert averaging as the engine of "plasticity" and Primal averaging as the anchor of "stability". This inspires our novel optimizer, SPIN (Stability-Plasticity INterpolation), which explicitly decouples plasticity and stability by interpolating between a fast-moving "plasticity" sequence and an adaptive "stability" sequence. We theoretically demonstrate that SPIN implicitly employs an inverse Hessian approximation, providing crucial Tikhonov regularization to damp noisy, single-sample Hessian estimates and mitigate forgetting. More importantly, SPIN can be seamlessly integrated into existing OCL methods by taking resulted gradients as input and replacing standard optimizers. Extensive experiments show that using SPIN instead of standard optimizers yields consistent and significant performance gains across multiple OCL approaches, including the challenging rehearsal-free setting and under strict memory constraints.

AI.brief_summary: 该文针对 online continual learning 中优化器仍沿用 SGD/AdamW 的现状，提出 SPIN 优化器：用 Polyak-Ruppert 平均对应「可塑性」序列、Primal 平均对应「稳定性」序列，在两者间插值以解耦稳定性与可塑性，并论证其隐含逆 Hessian 近似与 Tikhonov 正则，可直接替换现有 OCL 方法的优化器。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理无直接关系，但其「快变可塑性序列 + 自适应稳定序列」的梯度级插值与噪声抑制，可供核查是否能用于 LVR/VLM 推理的序贯或持续训练，以缓解对噪声轨迹监督的过拟合与能力遗忘。

title: SAPD: Learning from Agent Experience without Environment Interaction
summary: Scaling the training of Large Language Model (LLM) agents typically requires a large collection of executable environments, whose construction, maintenance, and operation constrain the expansion of training experience. Existing offline trajectories offer an opportunity to reuse interaction experience, yet effectively refining the current policy without revisiting these environments remains challenging: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can lead to catastrophic forgetting, while online reinforcement learning requires real-time interaction with the environment. To address this challenge, we propose Step-Advantage Policy Distillation (SAPD), a method for learning from offline trajectories using relative step advantages. SAPD decomposes multi-turn trajectories into individual decision contexts for on-policy distillation, allowing the student to generate responses conditioned on recorded histories, and introduces relative step advantage signals to stabilize training. The entire process requires neither new environment observations nor additional multi-turn interactions. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-based QA show that SAPD improves performance across different teacher configurations, mitigates catastrophic forgetting compared with SFT, and runs at least $4.7\times$ faster per training step than online OPD. We will release our code soon.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SAPD，把离线多轮轨迹拆成单个决策上下文做 on-policy 蒸馏，并以相对 step advantage 稳定训练，无需再与环境交互即可改进策略。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按步优势做轨迹内贡献分配、并让学生模型在记录历史上重生成的做法，可供核查如何为 latent 推理轨迹提供步级监督与信用分配；但属纯文本 agent 场景，视觉状态与 latent 内容的迁移需另行验证。

title: LaLa-World: Scaling Latent World Models with Natural Language Actions
summary: This paper shows that JEPA-style latent world models (LWMs) can learn across diverse domains and data sources by adopting the language-conditioned interface of video generation models. We establish this approach as an effective and efficient basis for planning with imagination and downstream policy fine-tuning. To this end, we introduce LaLa-World, a Language-conditioned Latent World model that learns from simulation and robot trajectories together with broader image and video data. Two designs make this work. First, we describe both numerical actions and visual changes in language, enabling joint training of a single future predictor across heterogeneous datasets. Second, we build the predictor on a language model, allowing it to interpret language conditions while predicting future latent states. The resulting predictor achieves higher average MPC planning performance than existing LWMs trained separately for each domain or task. Adding image and video data further improves average planning performance and robustness to action phrasing. In a matched comparison with an RAEv2-based video generation model baseline, LaLa-World reaches comparable planning performance with $6\times$ less training cost and $13.9\times$ faster planning. Beyond planning, the pretrained LaLa-World serves as an initialization for LaLa-Policy, which jointly predicts actions and future visual representations. LaLa-Policy performs competitively with Cosmos Policy on LIBERO and RoboCasa, with up to $5.5\times$ faster inference.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LaLa-World：以语言描述数值动作与视觉变化，用语言模型作为预测器，在仿真、机器人轨迹及图像视频数据上联合训练 JEPA 式 latent world model，并用于 MPC 规划与策略微调。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「语言作为动作/变化接口 + 跨域共享 latent 未来状态预测」可供核查多模态推理中预测表示与状态更新的接口设计，但目标是机器人规划而非 VLM 推理，迁移性需阅读原文判断。

title: Physical Operating-Condition-Guided Vision-Language Matching for Cavitation Diagnosis in Industrial Pipeline Systems
summary: Cavitation diagnosis in industrial pipeline systems is challenging because acoustic responses vary substantially with operating conditions, while similar time-frequency patterns may correspond to different cavitation states. To address this issue, we propose a physical operating-condition-guided vision-language matching (POC-VLM) for cavitation diagnosis. POC-VLM first constructs physical operating-condition-aware semantic descriptions by explicitly incorporating sample-specific operating variables into candidate cavitation texts. A time-frequency-conditioned text adaptation module then dynamically aligns these physical semantics with the observed acoustic response, followed by global-local vision-language matching to capture both holistic and localized discriminative patterns. In parallel, a K-nearest neighbours-based non-parametric physical operating-condition prior estimates the physical plausibility of each candidate state and is fused with the vision-language semantic evidence at the decision level. Experiments on three real-world cavitation datasets show that POC-VLM consistently outperforms representative data-driven, multimodal and domain-specific diagnostic methods. Further analyses verify the complementary roles of vision-language semantic matching and physical operating-condition priors, while demonstrating robust performance under varying sampling rates, noise levels and observation durations.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 POC-VLM，把工况变量写入候选空化状态的文本描述，用时间-频率条件化的文本适配与全局-局部视觉语言匹配对齐声学响应，并在决策层融合 KNN 估计的工况先验，用于工业管道空化诊断。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究对象是声学时频图与文本的匹配分类，并非 LVR；但「按样本条件重写候选描述 + 将语义匹配证据与非参数先验在决策层融合」可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与候选状态打分的方式。

title: Automatic Differentiation with Constraints in Forward and Inverse Problems
summary: Approximate solutions of partial differential equations (PDEs) on unstructured grids can be represented on a graph. Numerical optimization involving stiff evolutionary and static PDEs often requires solving a large system of equations, which can be treated as a constraint. In this work, we present a fully differentiable graph-based implicit solver that incorporates this constraint. We evaluate its performance across four key tasks: a) linear and nonlinear forward modeling of evolutionary and static problems, b) solving inverse problems to estimate equation coefficients, c) solving inverse problems to estimate the right-hand side, and d) learnable graph coarsening to accelerate forward modeling. The stability and differentiability of our solver enable significant reductions in the complexity of forward modeling while efficiently addressing related inverse problems. These capabilities make it a powerful tool for different physics and engineering applications, in particular for geophysics, where inverse problems are commonly solved in order to reduce the model uncertainty.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一种基于图表示、可完全微分的隐式求解器，将刚性PDE的大规模方程组作为约束处理，并在正演建模、两类反问题与可学习图粗化四类任务上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其隐式约束求解与通过反问题求梯度/系数的思路，可能为LVR中「预测式工作区」的状态更新与限制条件、以及latent状态的训练监督提供方法线索，需核查可微隐式层的稳定性与计算成本。

title: EndoWorld-JEPA: Motion-Guided Global-Local Latent World Modeling for Endoscopic Video Representation Learning
summary: Endoscopic video contains state transitions induced by camera displacement, deformable tissue, and instrument interaction, yet existing pre-training methods treat dynamics implicitly. Inspired by action-conditioned joint-embedding predictive world models and by the observation that endoscopic optical flow contains both shared image-plane displacement and localized residual motion, we reformulate passive endoscopic video pre-training as causal motion-guided latent-state prediction. We present EndoWorld-JEPA, to our knowledge the first latent world-model pre-training framework designed for general-purpose endoscopic video representation learning. In place of recorded actions, calibrated poses, or robot kinematics, the model conditions prediction of the next latent state on motion observed up to the current state. Its Optical Motion-guided module separates dominant displacement from residual motion and converts the resulting evidence into an ordered temporal motion condition and spatial local-motion weights. Complementary global and motion-local predictors use these outputs: the temporal condition modulates both latent transitions, whereas the local weights define an auxiliary motion-local state that extends prediction from scene-level evolution to spatially selective dynamics. Patch-wise motion weighting emphasizes localized change while retaining anatomical context, and past-motion-window dropout randomly withholds the complete motion condition to reduce dependence on unreliable motion. This global--local formulation learns predictable visual--motion dynamics in representation space without reconstructing stochastic appearance artifacts. Evaluation shows that a common pre-trained checkpoint achieves strong transfer across four downstream benchmarks, supporting motion-guided global--local latent prediction as an effective pre-training paradigm for endoscopic video.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 EndoWorld-JEPA，一个面向内窥镜视频的 latent world-model 预训练框架：从光流中分离全局位移与局部残差运动，以其条件化全局和局部 latent 状态预测，并借助 past-motion-window dropout 降低对不可靠运动的依赖。
AI.relevance_reason: 其运动条件化的 latent 状态预测、global-local 状态分解与运动条件丢弃，可能为 LVR 的视觉状态更新、局部证据保留及不可靠观测鲁棒性提供方法线索；但该工作不涉及推理、答案对 latent 的使用或停止决策，需较多核查。

title: Physical-Variable-Informed Deep Learning for Robust Diagnosis in Industrial Fluid Transport Systems
summary: Industrial fluid transport systems are monitored through heterogeneous sensing streams, but robust fault diagnosis remains difficult because response signals vary with operating conditions and differ from physical variables in sampling rate, observation duration and data granularity. To address these challenges, we propose a physical-variable-informed deep learning framework (PhyNet) for robust fault diagnosis under real-world sampling heterogeneity. PhyNet treats physical variables as global operating constraints and response signals as local diagnostic evidence. Its physical-to-response cross-attention mechanism connects sequence-level physical-variable tokens with a learnable global response token, enabling interaction without strict temporal alignment. Across four benchmarks, including three real-world cavitation datasets and one public two-phase-flow dataset, PhyNet achieves the best performance across all evaluated metrics. Class-wise analyses, together with attention and masking analyses, show improved discrimination of ambiguous states and indicate that physical variables meaningfully constrain local response interpretation. These findings demonstrate a deployment-oriented approach to robust diagnosis in heterogeneous industrial environments.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PhyNet 框架，将物理变量当作全局运行约束、响应信号当作局部诊断证据，用物理到响应的 cross-attention 在无需严格时间对齐的情况下融合采样率与粒度异构的传感流，并在多个工业故障诊断基准上评估，辅以注意力与掩码分析。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「全局约束 token 通过 cross-attention 调制局部证据」的做法，及用注意力/掩码分析查验约束是否真的被使用，可能为 LVR 中把物理或几何先验注入 latent 状态、以及视觉证据筛选的归因核验提供方法线索，需进一步核查。

title: Staged Continual Adaptation of Multimodal Foundation Models for Japanese Financial Documents
comment: 17 pages, 10 figures, 9 tables. Presented at the ICML 2026 Workshop "Continual Adaptation at Scale: Towards Sustainable AI". Code: https://github.com/AtsushiYanaigsawa768/Compass
summary: Staged post-training of multimodal foundation models chains vision-language alignment, reasoning distillation, and domain tuning, yet how each phase trades capabilities against the others remains under-characterised. Tracking an 8.4B-parameter model from an un-fine-tuned baseline through three training phases on Japanese financial documents (evaluated on five text-input benchmarks), we find the phases interact non-additively: math-only distillation overwrites the financial knowledge acquired earlier even as procedural math skill survives, and the domain phase repairs more than it installs. A skip-phase ablation is best for domain knowledge but forfeits numerical-reasoning gains, so per-phase contributions are not decomposable and the best checkpoint is task-dependent, with implications for checkpoint retention and scheduling rather than added stages.

AI.brief_summary: 追踪一个 8.4B 多模态模型在日文金融文档上依次经过对齐、推理蒸馏与领域微调三阶段的演化，发现各阶段效果非可加：数学蒸馏会覆盖先前获得的金融知识，跳过某阶段的消融领域知识最好但失去数值推理收益，最优 checkpoint 依赖任务。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文不研究 latent 推理或视觉证据使用（评测为文本输入基准），但分阶段训练相互干扰、贡献不可分解与最优检查点依赖任务等结论，可供核查 LVR 多阶段轨迹训练的遗忘与调度线索。

title: World Models with Configurable Perception
summary: Real-world observations are noisy and often contain excessive task-irrelevant information. Effective world modeling and planning need to abstract observations into world state representations while filtering out irrelevant information. However, encoders in existing world models are typically non-adaptive, leading to state representations that are easily distracted by task-irrelevant information. As a result, the model may not selectively filter observations to cater to different task demands. To address this problem, we introduce ConfigWM, which realizes configurable perception through task-conditioned state extraction. Given a language description of the task at hand, ConfigWM uses it as a configuration signal to steer how visual embeddings are mapped into a task-specific state space, selectively preserving information relevant to the current task while suppressing task-irrelevant variations. Action-conditioned dynamics are then learned in this task-specific state space for planning. We evaluate ConfigWM in environments with increasing levels of distraction. While existing methods exhibit substantial declines in planning success rate as the environments become increasingly noisy, ConfigWM remains comparatively stable and outperforms the strongest competing method by 22.3% on average across diverse environments. Consistent gains in physical-quantity probing (+0.365 Pearson r) and distracted-to-clean retrieval (+75.5%) further indicate that ConfigWM learns states that preserve task-relevant information while remaining robust to distractors, supporting reliable world modeling and planning in noisy worlds. Project Page: https://configwm.github.io

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ConfigWM：以语言任务描述作为配置信号，引导视觉嵌入映射到任务特定状态空间，抑制与任务无关的变化，再在该空间学习动作条件动力学用于规划；在干扰递增的环境中规划成功率比最强基线平均高 22.3%。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「任务条件化状态抽取＋物理量探测与干扰-干净检索」的编码器与评测线索，可能为 LVR 中按任务筛选视觉证据、构造任务必要 latent 状态提供借鉴，但需核查抑制干扰时是否丢掉了推理所需细节。

title: Quantum-JEPA: Quantum Born Priors for Latent-Action JEPA World Models
summary: A single observation can admit several plausible futures, making uncertainty an essential part of world modelling. However, quantum generative models remain underexplored for this task. We introduce Quantum-JEPA, a latent-action JEPA framework that learns distributions of future representations using a conditional quantum Born prior. Circuit measurements generate binary latent actions, which a shared predictor maps to alternative future representations. We train the quantum prior through the quality and diversity of these predictions using a sampled energy objective. Our model learns distinct continuations on constructed multimodal tasks and captures latent-action correlations that support coordinated multi-agent futures. On D3IL, a benchmark of diverse human demonstrations, our trained models generate multiple obstacle-crossing routes from a common starting point without observed motion. On the controlled tasks, our classical and quantum prior implementations improve prediction validity and distributional fidelity over the evaluated variational baselines. Our quantum priors combine competitive predictive quality with a parameter-efficient sampling structure: they avoid an exponentially sized categorical output layer while supporting correlated latent actions. We further validate finite-shot parameter-shift training, including training with readout noise. Unlike most prior work, which focuses on simulation, we also verify the feasibility of inference with trained priors on a real QPU. These results establish a trainable quantum component for JEPA future prediction and a basis for exploring quantum-enhanced world models at larger scales.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Quantum-JEPA：以条件量子 Born 先验从电路测量采样二值 latent action，再由共享 predictor 映射为多个未来表示，并在多模态任务、D3IL 及真实 QPU 上检验预测有效性与分布保真度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「latent action 采样＋能量目标」可供核查 LVR 中多假设推理状态如何生成、保持多样性并筛选有效轨迹；量子硬件部分与主线关联较弱。

title: From Comparison to Selection: Enhancing Cross-Scale Generalization of Pointer Networks Trained with Reinforcement Learning for Capacitated Drone Delivery Routing
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) enable fast, flexible last-mile and emergency delivery, but their routing remains challenging as the number of clients varies. Classical approaches based on mixed-integer programming and heuristics can scale poorly or require problem-specific design, motivating learning-based alternatives. Reinforcement learning is particularly promising, provided a single policy can generalize across problem sizes without retraining. Although attention-based Pointer Networks are inherently size-agnostic, their solution quality degrades under both upscaling and downscaling. Using the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP) as a controlled proxy, with fixed capacity reflecting drone payload constraints, we investigate this degradation and identify three contributing factors: shifts in node density, attention dispersion, and dilution of the mean-pooled graph context. We systematically compare architecture-wide, encoder-side, and decoder-side modifications to address these limitations and propose a learned, permutation-invariant graph-context aggregation mechanism, implemented as a weighted average and as Set2Set. Results reveal distinct requirements for transfer in each direction: entropy-based attention scaling reduces the CVRP20-to-CVRP100 performance gap by 1.41 percentage points, while the proposed aggregation methods achieve the largest improvement on the more challenging CVRP100-to-CVRP20 transfer, approximately 0.9 percentage points. Exploiting this complementarity, we introduce an approach selector that chooses the best model for each training-target size pair. The selector reduces cost relative to the reference model across all nine seen train-test pairs and eight of nine pairs involving unseen sizes (CVRP35, CVRP75, and CVRP200), achieving improvements of up to 3.2 percent.

AI.brief_summary: 论文以固定容量的 CVRP 作代理研究 Pointer Network 的跨规模泛化退化，诊断出节点密度偏移、注意力弥散与均值池化图上下文被稀释三个因素，比较编码器/解码器多处改动，提出置换不变的可学习图上下文聚合（加权平均与 Set2Set）及基于熵的注意力缩放，并加一个按规模对挑选模型的选择器。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「规模变化引起注意力弥散与池化上下文稀释」的诊断以及熵式注意力缩放、置换不变集合聚合，可能为 LVR 的长度泛化与推理状态聚合提供可核查的方法线索，但任务本身是路径优化，与视觉或多模态推理无直接联系。

title: Near-Duplicate Image Selection Transfers Preferences in Vision-Language Models
summary: Subliminal learning is the phenomenon in which a model transmits its preferences to another model through data that do not explicitly express them. As models increasingly curate training data for other models, we ask whether this transfer can arise from choosing among near-duplicate images while keeping the source photographs and human-written captions fixed. For each photograph, a curator selects one of eight near-duplicate variants by caption likelihood, without target-specific prompts. Students trained on target-preferring curators' selections show higher mean target-versus-alternatives log-likelihood ratios in an image-free readout than students trained on neutral selections. Under a prespecified decision rule, this directional shift appears for an owl target in LLaVA-1.5, Qwen2.5-VL, Qwen3-VL, and Gemma 4, with curators and students initialized from the same base checkpoint, and target rotations move it toward camels, oak trees, and a political figure. The owl target-selected student also scores above all count-matched random-reselection students in three models and above 55 of 60 in LLaVA-1.5, and Qwen3-VL shows the shift again on a new source bank with newly trained curators. Its size depends on dataset size, learning rate, and training budget; greedy choices among the eight options move toward the target by 10.4 percentage points in Qwen3-VL and 0.5-1.3 points elsewhere. First-generation students also pass the owl preference to a second generation through captions without explicit owl mentions in LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen3-VL. Thus even a deduplication-style choice among near-identical copies can shift students' target-relative readouts with source photographs and captions fixed; the tested linear probes classify the selecting arm with accuracies up to 59.7% (chance 50%).

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究「阈下学习」：固定原图与人工标题，仅由 curator 按标题似然从八张近重复变体中择一组成训练数据，发现学生 VLM 在无图读出中对目标概念的对数似然比升高，且可经标题跨代传递；线性探针最高以 59.7% 识别选择来源。
AI.relevance_reason: 其中的「无图读出」与线性探针可供核查 LVR 中答案是否真正依赖视觉 latent 内容、是否存在视觉旁路；但论文关注数据筛选引起的偏好传递而非推理状态生成，迁移线索需核查。

title: In PRAISE of Attributes: Grounding Retrieval Geometry with Query-Conditioned Subspaces for Person Re-Identification
summary: Person re-identification (ReID) ranks an image gallery using either an image query or a textual query. In image-to-image (I2I) ReID, viewpoint, illumination, occlusion, and background changes can make distractors appear more similar than the true match. In text-to-image (T2I) ReID, incomplete or ambiguous descriptions may omit key visual evidence. We study this problem for vision-language model (VLM) based ReID, where attributes such as clothing color and carried objects provide useful fine-grained matching cues. However, directly using attribute-prompt similarities as retrieval scores is unreliable because templated prompts can be biased, correlated, and poorly calibrated. We therefore propose \textbf{PR}ompt-guided \textbf{A}ttribute-based \textbf{I}nference-time \textbf{S}imilarity \textbf{E}nhancement (\texttt{PRAISE}), a query-side test-time adaptation framework for VLM-based ReID. Instead of treating prompts as scores, \texttt{PRAISE} uses a transferable attribute-prompt bank to construct an \emph{Attribute-Conditioned Subspace} (ACS): a query-dependent low-rank subspace induced by the most compatible attribute prompts. ACS provides a controlled attribute-conditioned geometry for reshaping query--gallery affinities and guiding lightweight inference-time updates without identity or attribute labels. Experiments across multiple I2I- and T2I-ReID benchmarks show that \texttt{PRAISE} consistently improves VLM retrieval backbones and outperforms both generic and ReID-specific TTA baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对 VLM 行人重识别中属性提示相似度有偏且校准差的问题，提出 PRAISE：用可迁移的属性提示库为每个查询构建低秩的「属性条件子空间」，借此重塑查询—图库相似度，并在无身份与属性标签下做推理时轻量更新。
AI.relevance_reason: 以查询条件化子空间控制相似度几何、并用属性提示充当细粒度证据，可能与 LVR 关注的 latent 相似度中内容与位置结构、视觉证据筛选有方法线索可核查，但本身不是 latent 推理状态生成。

title: Recast the Past: Stable Long Video Generation with Full Context Memory
summary: Long-horizon video generation requires retaining an ever-expanding history, but conditioning on its growing token sequence is costly. Existing methods restrict or compress historical context, potentially losing information needed for future generation. This work proposes ReCam, which groups local spatiotemporal blocks of historical latents into vectors and projects them directly into the high-dimensional hidden space of a Diffusion Transformer. The model learns to use the resulting memory tokens through native self-attention, reducing token count while retaining block-level access to the full history. To mitigate temporal drift during autoregressive rollout, we further introduce dual-pointer denoising with separate noise schedules for recent context and target frames. Among the evaluated methods, ReCam achieves the highest VBench-Long overall score of 80.1 and competitive static-scene revisitation performance on R2M-Bench. It also leads on all four consistency metrics for off-screen subject reappearance, including clothing consistency of 4.09 versus 3.03 for the best baseline.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ReCam：把长视频历史 latent 的局部时空块聚合成向量并直接投影到 Diffusion Transformer 的高维隐空间作为 memory token，经原生自注意力读取全历史；另用对近期上下文与目标帧采用不同噪声调度的双指针去噪缓解自回归漂移，在 VBench-Long 等基准取得高分。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「块级压缩历史 latent 再由自注意力读取」可为 LVR 在有限 token 下保留视觉证据、维持长程状态提供方法线索，近期/目标分离的噪声调度也可能关联长程状态更新的漂移问题，但是否可迁移到推理期状态而非视频生成仍需核查。

title: Dancing Diffusion: Learning Continuous Programs for Image Generation and Editing
summary: Diffusion models generate samples through a multi-step denoising trajectory, yet condition every step on the same instruction, so the trajectory cannot be addressed at the level of individual operations. We introduce Dancing Diffusion, which assigns each span of timesteps a dedicated continuous condition block and thereby turns conditioning into a latent program. A compiler maps text features into this program, and a fixed pretrained generator executes its blocks over successive sampling intervals. The trajectory can then dance, keeping its executed history while its continuation is redirected. A shared prefix is executed once and reused, and a later operation is rewritten while content fixed by earlier operations is preserved. The compiler is trained through the images it produces, with visual feedback on both the requested change and the retained content. On SANA, reusing an executed prefix preserves markedly more of the scene than regenerating from noise at a similar strength of edit, learned conditions preserve more background than native prompt switching from the same saved state, and the learned program improves generation quality over native SANA. Later branches weaken the edit, which leaves semantic control over individual operations limited. By converting a single-instruction trajectory into a program of addressable operations, Dancing Diffusion lays a foundation for structured intermediate computation in diffusion models.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作把文本指令编译为按时间步区间分配的一串连续条件块，形成可寻址的「latent program」，由固定的预训练扩散生成器分段执行，并以生成图像的同时反馈（改动与内容保留）训练编译器，从而实现前缀复用与后续操作改写。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽属图像生成而非视觉推理，但其把单一条件轨迹拆成可寻址操作块、复用已执行前缀并在保留既有内容的前提下重定向后续生成，可能为 LVR 中分段 latent 状态的控制、局部改写与计算复用提供方法线索，可供核查其可迁移性。

title: AdaptMIL: Domain Adaptation for Multiple Instance Learning in Digital Pathology
summary: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) support a wide range of histopathology tasks on whole-slide images through multiple instance learning (MIL). Despite recent progress, these models remain sensitive to cross-hospital distribution shifts: performance often degrades when a task head (e.g., classification) is trained on data from one hospital and then used on data from another hospital. To address this challenge, we propose AdaptMIL, a training strategy for integrating domain adaptation into MIL training. AdaptMIL is motivated by our finding that directly applying domain adaptation objectives during MIL training can interfere with MIL aggregation learning, often resulting in performance degradation over standard training. AdaptMIL resolves this by decoupling representation-level domain alignment learning from MIL aggregation learning through a two-stage training procedure. We show that AdaptMIL improves cross-hospital performance and outperforms alternative adaptation methods across experiments spanning multiple WSI datasets, tasks, PFMs, MIL architectures, and domain adaptation objectives. AdaptMIL's code will be released upon publication.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 AdaptMIL 两阶段训练策略，把表示层面的域对齐与 MIL 聚合学习解耦，以改善跨医院数字病理任务的迁移表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其发现「直接加入域适配目标会干扰聚合学习」并采用解耦训练，可能可供核查如何分离视觉表示适配与 latent 证据聚合训练；与 LVR 主线无直接关联。

title: RANGER: Retrieval Agent for Navigating Graphs with Semantic Evaluation Rewards
summary: The integration of Large Language Models and Reinforcement Learning offers a promising direction for complex sequential decision-making tasks, such as multi-hop question answering over knowledge graphs. While LLMs provide strong semantic understanding and reasoning capabilities, they often struggle with precise, multi-step navigation in structured environments. Conversely, RL agents excel at learning navigation policies but are hindered by the difficulty of designing semantically meaningful reward functions. This paper introduces a novel hybrid approach in which an LLM serves as a mentor to an RL agent during training by providing dense, semantically informed reward signals. The RL agent, built on a Transformer-based policy and trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization, learns to navigate a knowledge graph to retrieve relevant information. The LLM evaluates the semantic relevance of the agent's traversed paths, generating reward signals that align the agent's behavior with the information needs expressed in a query. We integrate this Retrieval Agent for Navigating Graphs with Semantic Evaluation Rewards (RANGER) into a complete question-answering pipeline and evaluate it on the open question answering datasets. Experimental results show that the proposed approach outperforms both a baseline retrieval-augmented system with classical graph search and one using an RL agent trained with heuristic rewards, achieving a significant increase in NLP metrics and LLM-as-a-Judge scores. Our findings demonstrate that deep integration of LLMs into the RL training loop yields more effective and semantically aligned retrieval policies for complex reasoning tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RANGER：以 Transformer 策略网络构建知识图谱导航检索智能体，用 GRPO 训练，并由 LLM 对智能体已走路径的语义相关性给出稠密奖励，再接入多跳问答流程评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 「LLM 评判中间检索轨迹并转为稠密奖励」这一训练监督思路，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据获取与轨迹级贡献分配提供线索，其奖励能否真正引导有效取证与停止决策待核查。

title: Spherical Geometry-Aware Panoptic Scene Graph Generation for Equirectangular Panoramas
summary: Panoptic scene graph generation (PSGG) represents scene entities with segmentation masks and directed relations. Equirectangular projection (ERP) panoramas challenge PSGG through distortion, latitude-dependent pixel areas, and an artificial seam. We propose a two-stage spherical geometry-aware framework that fuses overlapping perspective-view predictions using observation reliability, spherical overlap, and angular proximity. Relation reasoning combines spherical-area-aware aggregation, weighted no-relation supervision, and dual-longitude score fusion. We also construct a dataset of 340 high-resolution panoramas with 10,571 nodes and 6,632 directed relations. Against corresponding baselines, spherical fusion improves PQ by 36.03% under matched views, while relation reasoning improves mR@50 by 11.20% under PredCls with ground-truth masks and object labels. The full framework improves mR@50 by 52.99% under SGDet with predicted panoptic segments. These results demonstrate the value of spherical geometry for panoramic PSGG.

AI.brief_summary: 面向等距柱状投影全景图的全景场景图生成，提出两阶段球面几何感知框架：依观测可靠性、球面重叠与角度邻近融合多个透视视图预测，并在关系推理中引入球面面积感知聚合、加权无关系监督与双经度分数融合，同时构建 340 幅全景图数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但其按可靠性与重叠度加权融合多视角预测、并抑制虚假关系的做法，可供核查是否用于 latent 推理中多源视觉证据的筛选与聚合。

title: Assessing Representation Semantics Under Language Pretraining in Fine-Grained Classification
summary: Understanding how supervision signals shape semantic visual representations remains challenging, particularly in fine-grained, low-data settings. Standard evaluations of vision models rely on downstream accuracy, which often fails to capture structural differences in learned representations. We propose a compact explainability-driven framework for comparing encoders trained with classification-only and caption-generation supervision on CUB-200. Using a controlled two-stage protocol in which both encoders are ultimately optimized for the same classification task, we enable a direct comparison of the resulting representations. Saliency maps are generated using attention rollout and gradient-weighted rollout and evaluated with five metrics covering faithfulness (positive and negative perturbation) and localization (keypoint emphasis, background attribution, and Earth Mover's Distance). Across random seeds and explanation methods, caption supervision yields representations that are more sensitive to the removal of salient regions, better aligned with annotated object parts, and less reliant on background regions, whereas classification supervision produces representations that are slightly more robust to the removal of low-saliency regions. An ablation study on the Oxford-IIIT Pet dataset shows consistent trends across key metrics. These results demonstrate that the proposed framework makes supervision-induced representational differences observable and quantifiable beyond downstream accuracy alone. More broadly, it provides a systematic basis for assessing learned representations and comparing alternative training and transfer-learning strategies.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一个以可解释性为驱动的紧凑比较框架：在 CUB-200 上用同一分类任务的两阶段控制协议，对比仅分类监督与 caption 生成监督所得编码器，并以 attention rollout 类显著图和五项保真度、定位指标量化表示差异。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「显著区域扰动保真度 + 部件对齐 + 背景归因」指标可供核查能否用于诊断 LVR 内部状态是否保留细粒度视觉证据、是否依赖背景等视觉旁路，但需核查其与推理期 latent 状态和语言解码过程的适配性。

title: MuPACE: Learning to Pace Muon for LoRA Fine-Tuning
summary: Learning rate schedules are typically fixed before training begins, yet when fine-tuning large language models with low-rank adapters (LoRA), the appropriate scale varies substantially with the model, task, and adapter configuration. Practitioners re-tune a schedule for every new problem, yet a tuned schedule still cannot react to the training dynamics it encounters. We instead amortize learning rate selection across LoRA fine-tuning problems. We leave the base optimizer, Muon, untouched, so that its normalized update fixes the direction, and meta-learn only the global step size. Our method MuPACE is a small recurrent policy, meta-trained across a distribution of fine-tuning runs, that conditions on the observed trajectory and emits bounded adjustments to an interpretable analytic schedule. On 64 fine-tuning problems, MuPACE outperforms standard fixed schedules at a strong shared default on 64-78% of problems and is on par with the same schedules with per-task tuned peaks. Meta-trained only on models with up to 16 layers, MuPACE transfers one-shot to unseen tasks on models as deep as 64 layers, such as Qwen3-32B and Qwen3.8-27B, where a single run remains competitive with swept schedules.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MuPACE：在 LoRA 微调中保持 Muon 优化器方向不变，仅用一个小型循环策略依据训练轨迹元学习全局步长的有界调整，以摊销学习率调度选择，并在 64 个微调问题及更深的未见模型上验证一次性迁移。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「循环策略读取轨迹历史、输出有界动作、跨规模一次迁移」的线索可供核查，可能类比 LVR 中依据推理轨迹动态调节计算投入的控制器，但研究目标为优化超参而非视觉推理。

title: Slot-JEPA: Object-Structured Prediction Interfaces for Latent World Models
summary: As a prototypical latent world model, Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) provide strong semantic representations. However, dense patch representations expose a redundant interface to downstream predictors, which must implicitly infer spatial organization and temporal correspondence, presenting three challenges. First, object information is distributed across patches, forcing each downstream predictor to redundantly recover object structure that could otherwise be reused across tasks before modeling interactions. Second, the lack of explicit entity correspondence across time makes historical transitions expensive, restricting the predictor's flexibility in utilizing context. Third, without explicit transport structure, existing JEPA models typically use pointwise l1/l2 distances, which are insensitive to spatial displacement when predicted and goal supports are largely disjoint. We propose the Slot-based Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (Slot-JEPA), which decomposes dense representations into stable semantic slots and time-varying spatial masks. Pretrained once and frozen downstream, this decomposition exposes a reusable object-structured interface. Building on it, our Transition Memory Predictor (TMP) stores visual transitions as compact masks and retrieves useful context using statistics of corresponding slots. Its two branches separate slot-specific dynamics from shared cross-slot dynamics. We further use Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT) to supervise mask prediction and evaluate candidate plans by transporting mass between aligned predicted and goal masks, providing a signal better aligned with spatial progress. Across seven visual-understanding benchmarks, the slot-reconstructed features remain transferable. Slot-JEPA also improves goal-conditioned planning across six planar environments and four robotic arm planning tasks on the REALM-JEPA benchmark.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Slot-JEPA，把 JEPA 的稠密 patch 表示分解为稳定语义 slot 与随时间变化的空间 mask，并配合基于 slot 统计的转移记忆预测器与 UOT 监督，用于跨任务特征迁移和目标条件规划。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「对象结构化 latent 接口」和用 mask 搬运距离替代逐点 l1/l2 的做法，可能为 LVR 中实体与几何信息的保留及 latent 状态比较提供线索，但是否适用于 VLM 推理状态仍需核查。

title: MoDDiT: Simple Token Routing in Diffusion Transformers
summary: Real-time video generation, interactive world models, and on-device image synthesis are almost a reality. Diffusion Transformers (DiT) achieve excellent sample quality, shifting the bottleneck to the throughput of the models themselves. Natural images are inherently sparse, as large portions of an image are often background, contribute little to the scene content, and are easy to denoise. DiTs fail to exploit this sparsity, as they process image tokens statically and uniformly. We propose MoDDiT, a simple architecture modification that learns to route tokens through both MLP and self-attention operations. By routing tokens through both blocks independently, MoDDiT allows for dynamic compute allocation in MLPs that varies across tokens, images, and denoising timesteps. Using MoDDiT to train image generation models from scratch significantly reduces computational costs of training and inference, processing as few as 12.5% of the tokens. By increasing sparsity and model depth, MoDDiT reduces costs and improves generation performance over unrouted baselines. The learned allocation is interpretable, revealing how computation varies with visual content and noise level. We also use MoDDiT to train video generation models, where allocation correlates with motion, and to distill a dense bidirectional video model into a sparse autoregressive student.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MoDDiT，在 DiT 中让 token 分别独立地经 MLP 与自注意力进行路由，实现随 token、图像和去噪步变化的动态计算分配，仅处理约 12.5% 的 token 即可完成图像与视频生成训练，并可将稠密双向视频模型蒸馏为稀疏自回归学生。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按 token 与时间步学习计算分配、且分配结果可解释的做法，或可类比 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与动态计算预算；从稠密双向教师到稀疏自回归学生的蒸馏，可供核查轨迹式训练与贡献分配的迁移线索。

title: LatticeRank: Spacing-Ranked Consistency for Native-Grid 3D Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Variable voxel spacing changes more than image resolution: it alters the discrete sampling lattice, tensor geometry, and anatomical evidence available to a 3D segmentation network. While conventional pipelines restore images to a canonical grid, direct-grid deployment requires the model itself to tolerate these changes. We observe that candidate grids are not exchangeable views -- a coarse grid removes more structural information than a mildly resampled one -- yet standard consistency objectives assign them equal influence. We therefore propose LatticeRank, a training-only framework that aligns candidate posteriors in physical space and allocates consistency supervision by voxel-spacing order: among endpoint-matched candidates, the auxiliary loss concentrates on the coarsest requested grid, while inference retains a single network forward with no candidate branch or ensemble. On MSD Task04, LatticeRank improves coarse-grid Extra Dice over mean consistency by 0.03436 across five seeds while meeting the prespecified reference-grid noninferiority criterion. A controlled ladder shows that grid exposure provides the largest recovery, posterior consistency adds a second gain, and spacing-ranked allocation yields the strongest direct-grid result; requested spacing thus provides a simple, model-independent ordering signal for direct-grid consistency learning.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LatticeRank，一个仅在训练期使用的框架：在物理空间对齐候选网格的后验，并按体素间距顺序把一致性监督集中到最粗网格，推理仍只需单次前向。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「候选并非等价视图、按信息损失排序分配辅助监督」的思路，或可供核查 LVR 训练中视觉证据与辅助监督如何按信息量加权的问题；但任务为 3D 医学分割，与 latent 推理状态生成无直接联系。

title: Robust Representation Learning for Spiking Neural Networks based on Conditional Information Bottleneck
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have shown great potential for low-power neuromorphic computing due to their event-driven processing and spatiotemporal sparsity, but they remain vulnerable to input perturbations, hardware-intrinsic noise, and adversarial attacks in real-world deployment. We attribute this vulnerability partly to input-specific hidden representations learned by standard SNNs trained with conventional cross-entropy loss, as our information-plane analysis empirically shows that substantial input-related information can still be retained after label-predictive information becomes stable. To address this issue, we propose SCIB, a simple yet effective robust learning objective for SNNs based on the Conditional Information Bottleneck. Different from conventional variational IB methods, SCIB replaces the mutual information compression term $I(X;S)$ with the conditional mutual information $I(X;S|Y)$ and derives a tractable variational upper bound. Moreover, it introduces a learnable class-conditional prior instead of a label-agnostic isotropic Gaussian prior, improving the expressiveness of variational compression and encouraging class-structured representations when combined with the supervised classification objective. Systematic experiments on Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100 under external environmental noise, neuromorphic hardware noise, and adversarial attacks show that SCIB improves robustness over standard SNNs and IB-based baselines under most evaluated noise conditions, improves adversarial accuracy under the evaluated attacks without using adversarial training, and reduces the SynOps-based single-sample inference energy consumption by 24.9% relative to an unconstrained SNN baseline.

AI.brief_summary: 该文针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）对噪声与对抗扰动的脆弱性，提出 SCIB：以条件互信息 I(X;S|Y) 取代常规变分 IB 中的 I(X;S)，并引入可学习的类条件先验，在 Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR 等任务上提升鲁棒性并降低推理能耗。
AI.relevance_reason: 其信息平面分析与条件 IB 目标可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态如何在保留任务必要信息的同时压缩输入特有余项；但研究对象是 SNN 分类鲁棒性，与视觉推理无直接联系，迁移价值需阅读后判断。

title: Reliability-Guided Vision-Language Decoding with Text-Aware Skip Refinement for Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Medical image segmentation remains challenging when targets exhibit limited visual distinction, irregular structure, or substantial variation across imaging modalities. Medical text can reduce this ambiguity, but indiscriminate fusion may introduce unreliable guidance. We present RELiF, a vision--language framework that integrates text through reliability-guided decoding. Its Reliability-guided Fusion Gate (RFG) adaptively controls cross-modal updates, while the Text-guided Skip Refinement Adapter (TSRA) refines high-resolution features using text guidance. RELiF is evaluated on radiographic, CT, and endoscopic segmentation tasks, where it shows competitive performance across diverse imaging characteristics and target appearances. Additional analyses examine efficiency and stability. The complementary uncertainty representation derived from the reliability response also shows an association with prediction difficulty, with higher uncertainty values occurring more frequently in pixels associated with segmentation errors. Code: https://github.com/SeivanTalaie/RELiF.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RELiF 医学图像分割框架，用可靠性引导融合门控自适应控制文本带来的跨模态更新，并以文本引导的跳连精化适配器改善高分辨率特征，在放射、CT 与内镜任务上评估性能、效率与稳定性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其可靠性门控与由可靠性响应导出的不确定性，分别可能为 LVR 中视觉证据注入强度控制和错误/难度判别提供可核查线索，但该工作本身不涉及推理期 latent 状态生成。

title: PointForward V2: Point-Aligned Interaction for Feedforward Driving Reconstruction
summary: Feedforward reconstruction of dynamic driving scenes requires integrating observations across multiple views and time steps into a coherent 3D representation. PointForward established state-of-the-art feedforward driving reconstruction by lifting image observations into sparse 3D queries, demonstrating the effectiveness of point-aligned scene representations. However, these queries are largely processed independently, limiting information exchange across space and time, while direct global attention among tens of thousands of point queries is computationally prohibitive. In this work, we present \textbf{PointForward V2}, which advances point-aligned representation to point-aligned interaction. Our key idea is to mediate query interaction through compact, scene-structured registers. For the static background, frame-wise Static Scene Registers compress point information, communicate across frames, and propagate the aggregated context back to the queries. For each dynamic instance, queries from different frames are aligned in an object-centric canonical space and interact through instance-specific Dynamic Instance Registers. We further employ 4D positional encoding that combines aligned spatial coordinates with original timestamps, enabling spatially aligned yet temporally distinguishable interactions. In this way, PointForward V2 enables scalable spatio-temporal reasoning directly among lifted 3D queries without dense global attention. Experiments on Waymo, nuScenes, and Argoverse 2 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across large-scale driving benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 PointForward V2，用场景结构化的紧凑 registers 作为中介，让多视角、多帧的稀疏 3D point queries 在不做稠密全局注意力的情况下交换时空信息，并结合 4D 位置编码，在多个驾驶重建基准上取得 SOTA。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「registers 汇聚 query 信息并回传」的瓶颈式聚合结构，以及用对齐空间坐标加时间戳编码区分时空状态的 4D 位置编码，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的压缩聚合、位置与深度对 latent 相似度的影响提供可供核查的结构线索；但任务属驾驶重建，与 VLM 推理的联系需自行判断。

title: GAMF-Net: Grouped Availability-Aware Multimodal Fusion for Smartphone Skin Lesion Classification
summary: Smartphone clinical images provide a low-cost data source for computer-aided skin lesion classification in resource-constrained settings, but images alone cannot fully capture patients' medical histories and lesion symptoms. To address the lack of structured organization among heterogeneous clinical variables, the ambiguity between observed and imputed values, and the risk that clinical information may interfere with visual evidence, we propose GAMF-Net, a grouped availability-aware multimodal fusion network. Ten clinical variables are divided into three semantic groups---demographics, history-related risk, and lesion presentation---and each group jointly encodes field values and field-level availability masks. The image branch produces the base classification logits, while each clinical group generates image-conditioned class-level residual evidence. Only available groups participate in availability-normalized equal-weight fusion; when all clinical information is unavailable, the model reduces exactly to the image-only pathway. We evaluate the method on PAD-UFES-20 under a patient-disjoint five-fold protocol with separate training, validation, and test partitions. GAMF-Net achieves an Accuracy of $74.17\pm2.85\%$, a balanced accuracy (BACC) of $70.11\pm2.11\%$, a Macro-F1 of $68.85\pm0.85\%$, and a Macro-AUROC of $93.42\pm1.20\%$, outperforming all image-only and multimodal baselines reimplemented under a unified protocol. Compared with the strongest baseline, MetaBlock, the corresponding improvements are 2.37, 2.59, 4.14, and 1.02 percentage points, respectively. Ablation results show that clinical information substantially improves class-balanced performance, constrained equal-weight fusion is more effective than dynamic fusion, and the lesion-presentation group provides the most informative clinical complement.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GAMF-Net，将十个临床变量按人口学、病史风险、皮损表现分为三组，每组联合编码字段值与可用性掩码；图像分支给出基础分类 logits，各临床组产生以图像为条件的类级残差证据，仅可用组参与可用性归一化的等权融合，临床信息全缺失时严格退化为纯图像通路，并在 PAD-UFES-20 上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其可用性掩码门控的残差式辅助证据融合、以及「辅助信息全部缺失即退化为纯视觉通路」的设计，可能为 LVR 中控制非视觉证据对视觉证据的调制、抑制视觉旁路提供可核查的机制线索，但该文是图像分类任务，不涉及 latent 推理状态或轨迹生成。

title: Curriculum Learning for Generative Flexible Docking
comment: ML4Molecules: Agentic Systems for Molecular Sciences Workshop at NeurIPS 2026 Paris
summary: Flexible docking is a highly practical task, aiming to predict the joint configuration of a protein-ligand complex from a protein apo structure and a ligand SMILES string. Diffusion and flow-based generative models have made this task tractable by modeling the posterior distribution over the ligand pose and the protein conformation conditioned on the apo input. The central challenge, however, remains the long-tailed apo-to-holo structure shift, where a small fraction of protein undergo large conformational changes. In this work, motivated by the practical observation that downweighting large shift examples improves generalization, and by the mixed nature of the long tail consisting of genuinely difficult examples and noisy ones, we propose to use curriculum learning for this task, gradually incorporating large conformational change examples during training. With a linear pacing function, we show that an existing method can be strongly enhanced. On the PDBBind ESMFold apo benchmark, with relaxation and confidence-based pose selection, the resulting model GCLDock achieves a 46.52% top-1 success rate (ligand RMSD less than 2A) and 40.26% when additionally requiring PoseBusters validity, outperforming existing baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究柔性蛋白-配体对接，用课程学习配合线性 pacing 函数逐步引入大构象变化样本，增强扩散/流式生成模型，在 PDBBind ESMFold apo 基准上报告 46.52% top-1 成功率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其区分「真正困难」与「噪声」长尾样本并按课程逐步引入的训练调度，可能为 latent 推理轨迹训练中的难度分配与噪声轨迹筛选提供线索，但属跨领域借鉴，可供核查其是否迁移到推理监督。

title: CrossFit-GS: Out-of-Fold Pose Estimation for COLMAP-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Pose-free 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) aims to bypass cumbersome Structure-from-Motion (SfM) by directly reconstructing scenes from unposed image sequences. In this work, we present CrossFit-GS, a deferred-commitment progressive framework that mitigates cumulative trajectory drift and breaks the self-reinforcing loop of distorted-map error propagation. Specifically, we partition the input sequence into interleaved subsets and maintain two complementary submaps. Each candidate pose is cross-refined against a frozen opposite submap that has never been optimized using the target frame, thereby providing an independent geometric reference for pose estimation. Checkerboard validation and spatial coverage safeguards further reject unreliable updates, and only verified poses are committed to their corresponding owner submap. Once the trajectory has been refined, the intermediate submaps are discarded and the final global representation is trained from scratch using the fixed refined poses. Extensive evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that CrossFit-GS substantially reduces cumulative trajectory drift and consistently improves both camera pose estimation and novel-view synthesis over existing methods.

AI.brief_summary: CrossFit-GS 提出免位姿的 3DGS 重建框架：把输入序列划为交错子集并维护两个互补子图，候选位姿先与「从未用该帧优化过」的冻结对侧子图交叉精化，再经棋盘验证与空间覆盖检查，仅提交通过检验的位姿，最后以固定位姿重训全局表示。
AI.relevance_reason: 用冻结的互补子图作为独立几何参照来筛选并提交更新、抑制误差自增强，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态更新的验证式提交、视觉证据筛选与停止判断提供方法线索，需核查该类比的可迁移性。

title: Offline Makes Online Better: Calibrated Cache Compression for Video Generation
summary: Token merging is an effective approach to reducing KV-cache memory consumption in autoregressive video generation by clustering temporally redundant tokens and retaining only a small set of representatives. Existing methods, however, typically apply a uniform merging ratio across all attention layers and heads. We observe that different layers and heads exhibit substantially different yet jointly correlated sensitivities to token merging, and that these sensitivity patterns remain consistent across prompts. Based on this observation, we introduce CALM, a Calibrated Allocation for Layer-Head Merging that uses offline calibration to improve online cache compression. Exhaustively evaluating all possible layer-head allocations is prohibitively expensive. To enable efficient calibration, we show that attention-output error strongly correlates with end-to-end video quality and can therefore serve as a lightweight proxy for allocation risk assessment. We evaluate different allocation strategies using this proxy and construct a fixed layer-head risk map offline. Given a cache budget at inference time, CALM uses dynamic programming to determine the best allocation of merging ratios. Experiments across three different autoregressive video models demonstrate that CALM consistently outperforms uniform token merging under the same memory budget, by reducing the LPIPS to original videos by around 21% with higher video-quality scores.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CALM：先离线校准各层各头对 token 合并的敏感度，以注意力输出误差作为画质代理构建风险图，推理时用动态规划在固定缓存预算下分配层-头合并比例，用于自回归视频生成的 KV-cache 压缩。
AI.relevance_reason: 层-头敏感度差异、离线校准与误差代理可能为 LVR 中按层分配视觉细节保留或压缩预算、以及缓存结构对 latent 状态的影响提供核查线索，但研究对象是视频生成，迁移性有待验证。

title: Adaptive Pullback: Reweighting Supervision at Penalty Jumps in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises student-generated responses using sampled-token student-teacher log-ratios. A positive log-ratio penalizes a token that the student assigns higher probability to than the teacher, but its current value does not distinguish sustained high penalties from abrupt increases along a response. We examine these local changes by comparing consecutive blocks of tokens within the same response. Our diagnostic identifies penalty jumps, abrupt increases in average penalty that persist on held-out tokens. Across these jumps, penalties rise while teacher confidence decreases. We call this pattern penalty-confidence tension. Boundaries into high-penalty blocks do not exhibit comparable confidence changes, showing that local changes provide information beyond the current penalty value. Motivated by this observation, we propose Adaptive Pullback OPD (AP-OPD). At each detected jump, AP-OPD uses the preceding block as a local reference and uniformly scales all supervision coefficients in the following block so that its weighted average penalty matches the preceding block's original mean. This reference determines the scaling factor without an additional strength constant. AP-OPD improves performance on both mathematical reasoning and code generation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文诊断 on-policy 蒸馏中同一回复内学生-教师 log-ratio 的局部突变，发现「惩罚跳变」处惩罚上升而教师置信度下降，据此提出 AP-OPD：在检测到跳变时以前一块为局部参照，统一缩放后续块的监督系数，使加权平均惩罚对齐前一块原均值，并在数学推理与代码生成上报告提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作不含视觉或 latent 状态，但按块检测监督信号突变并自适应缩放系数、且免设强度常数的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 轨迹训练中的步级贡献分配与监督强度标定。

title: Reframing Object-Centric Reinforcement Learning: From Absolute to Relative Representations
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 10 pages Appendix, First two authors contributed equally
summary: Object-centric reinforcement learning agents typically receive each object's position in a fixed global frame, even though their decisions usually depend on where objects are relative to one another. These absolute views often fail to capture the local context that is most relevant to the agent's behavior. As a result, an agent must relearn the same response at every location where a configuration can occur, and its performance collapses when the scene is merely shifted. In this work, we propose a shift toward Object-Relative Coordinates fixed to Anchor (ORCA), where entities are described in a relative frame of reference. To operationalize this idea, we introduce Object-Relative inductive-Bias Transformers (ORBiT), a transformer-based architecture for processing anchor-relative inputs in reinforcement learning. Our results suggest these relative representations improve performance for both MLP and transformer agents. Furthermore, we demonstrate that ORBiT outperforms the pixel-based PPO baseline, achieving an aggregate HNS IQM greater than 1.0 over 13 Atari games. ORBiT learns the game of Foosball from scratch, dominating all baselines. In our controlled Tag environment, we further show that ORCA extends to rotations, that ORBiT generalizes to unseen numbers of distractors, and that these gains require a decision-relevant anchor.

AI.brief_summary: 论文主张在物体中心强化学习中用锚点固定的相对坐标（ORCA）取代全局绝对位置，并提出 ORBiT——以 transformer 处理锚点相对输入的架构，在 Atari 与受控 Tag 环境中验证相对表示对 MLP/transformer 智能体及平移、旋转、干扰物数量泛化的作用。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「相对坐标系 + 实体 token 编码」的思路可供核查：可能为 VLM 推理中实体关系与几何信息如何写入 latent 状态、以及位置偏移下的表示稳定性提供借鉴，但原文属 RL 而非视觉推理，有效性待验证。

title: Region-Guided Food-Package Evidence Extraction and Abstention-Aware Draft R3337 Screening with Selective VLM Review
summary: Applying South Africa's draft R3337 warning criteria to food-package photographs requires nutrition, ingredient and product-form evidence. This study presents a region-guided evidence extraction and abstention-aware screening workflow for draft R3337. A three-class detector localises nutrition information panels, ingredient lists and product-identity regions, after which PaddleOCR and structured extraction recover nutrient values, ingredient evidence and product-form information. Recovered evidence is aggregated and assessed using deterministic draft R3337 rules. When evidence is incomplete, uncertain or conflicting, the workflow abstains through Review or Insufficient evidence rather than forcing an automatic outcome. For qualifying unresolved cases, a selective vision-language model (VLM) review stage using Qwen3-VL 8B Instruct reassesses unresolved evidence. Accepted evidence is merged and the same deterministic rules are reapplied. The workflow was applied to 442 products represented by 3,929 images. Evaluation used a manual validation set of 65 products. Before selective VLM review, 31 of 60 decidable products received automatic outcomes and 30 were correct, giving 51.7% coverage and 96.8% accuracy among automatic outcomes (selective accuracy). Selective VLM review resolved eight additional products, increasing coverage to 65.0%. Of 39 automatic outcomes, 38 were correct, giving 97.4% selective accuracy. The single false warning was retained from the rules-only workflow, while no unsafe warning omissions occurred after selective review. Evidence-level evaluation nevertheless identified incorrect VLM-recovered nutrition, ingredient and product-form evidence. These findings show that selective VLM review can recover unresolved evidence, while deterministic screening and explicit abstention remain necessary for reliable image-based draft R3337 screening.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建了一套针对南非 R3337 草案的食品包装图像筛查流程：先用三分类检测器定位营养标签、配料表与产品标识区域，再用 PaddleOCR 与结构化抽取回收证据，按确定性规则判定，并在证据不全或冲突时选择弃权（Review / Insufficient evidence），仅对未解决案例调用 Qwen3-VL 进行选择性复核后合并证据重判。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「证据不足即弃权、仅对未解决案例触发 VLM 复核」的路由设计，可能为 LOOK/STOP 的触发条件与证据可靠性筛选提供借鉴线索；但论文聚焦法规筛查应用，未涉及内部 latent 状态，证据层面的 VLM 抽取错误也可供核查「模型是否真正使用了视觉证据」。

title: Convergent Performance, Divergent Mechanisms in LoRA-Adapted Vision Foundation Models for Brain MRI
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, Preprint submitted to Elsevier
summary: Adapting Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) to medical imaging via LoRA has become standard practice, yet model selection is guided almost entirely by downstream task metrics, treating backbones with similar performance as interchangeable. We investigate whether equal performance implies equal internal representational shift. We analyse four ViT-B/16 backbones, DINOv3, SigLIP2, MerMED-FM, and BiomedCLIP, pre-trained with different objectives (self-distillation vs. contrastive vision-language) and on different data domains (natural vs. medical images). We adapt each to brain tumour segmentation and evaluate on six datasets covering both segmentation and Alzheimer's disease classification. Using attention divergence, weight-change analysis, and activation patching, we find that the four models converge to similar segmentation performance (mean Dice 78-81%) through markedly different internal dynamics, yet diverge in cross-task transfer: segmentation adaptation improves Alzheimer's disease classification for DINOv3 but degrades it for the other three backbones. We reveal a dissociation between modification magnitude and causal importance: the most heavily modified layers are not the causally relevant ones, with early-to-mid layers identified as sufficient for segmentation recovery.
